definitions.gloss: vicious cycle; negative spiral; chain of negative events
definitions.explanation: A situation where one bad outcome leads to another, creating an ongoing cycle of negative consequences. Used in discussions of social problems, economics, and personal struggles.

examples.japanese: {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}を{断|た}ち{切|き}る。
{貧困|ひんこん}の{負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: The vicious cycle of poverty has become a problem.

examples.japanese: {睡眠|すいみん}{不足|ぶそく}とストレスの{負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}すのは{簡単|かんたん}ではない。
examples.english: It is not easy to escape the vicious cycle of sleep deprivation and stress.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently appears in news, social commentary, and self-help contexts. Often used with verbs describing breaking or escaping the cycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}を{断|た}ち{切|き}る (to break the vicious cycle)
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}に{陥|おちい}る (to fall into a vicious cycle)
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す (to escape the negative spiral)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}: vicious circle — nearly synonymous, but more formal and academic in tone
